def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                    for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
                        if not (dy or dx):
                            continue
                        yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                        if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                            seen.add((yy, xx))
                            q.append((yy, xx))
            ys = [p[0] for p in cells]
            xs = [p[1] for p in cells]
            y0, y1, x0, x1 = min(ys), max(ys), min(xs), max(xs)
            area = (y1-y0+1)*(x1-x0+1)
            # Rectangular objects survive as substantial, compact components; isolated
            # background speckles and other corrupting colors are discarded.
            if len(cells) >= 4 and y1 > y0 and x1 > x0 and len(cells)/area >= 0.30:
                for yy in range(y0, y1+1):
                    for xx in range(x0, x1+1):
                        out[yy][xx] = color
    return out
